system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Netherese archmages used comet-calling as a punchline to arguments. It's unclear whether they were joking.

Read this scroll as an Action while outdoors (or it's wasted) to bring a comet down on a point you can see within 1 Mile. It carves a 50-foot-deep, 500-foot-radius crater. Everything in that radius must pass [Reflex] or take 100 (30d10) damage, or half as much on a pass. All structures in the crater are destroyed, along with any unworn, unheld, nonmagical Objects.

It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Read it as an Action while outdoors to call a comet down on a point within 1 Mile, carving a 500-foot-radius crater. Everything in the radius must pass [Reflex] or take catastrophic damage. Indoors, the scroll is simply wasted. Consumed either way.

Value: 250000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
